notes: AL includes the verifier bonus token; AL is not an acceptance probability.
Original paper: T=1, non-thinking, 7 draft tokens, fixed-length verification, 9 tasks; DFlash and DSpark 5-layer backbones. Arithmetic means and deltas are recomputed from rounded table cells.
DFlash2 Qwen3-4B ablation is correction-only on GSM8K; cycle overhead is not a measured throughput improvement; absolute tok/s not reported there.
DFlash2 Qwen3.5-4B: matched training setup, thinking on, T=1, top_p=.95, top_k=20, presence_penalty=1.5. Author mean row rounds DSpark to 5.49 and DFlash2 to 5.97.
Released Qwen3.8 and Muse comparisons use community DSpark checkpoints, not the original DeepSeek paper checkpoints.
Official throughput cards: SGLang, one H200, FlashAttention3, max4096 tokens, C=1/8/32; Qwen3.8 uses 7 draft tokens and xhigh reasoning, Muse uses 15 and high reasoning.
All ratios and percentage changes in CSV are recomputed from displayed rounded values; final decimal can differ from author ratios computed with unrounded measurements.
Production moderate/strict SLA throughput gains are distinct from user TPS gains at matched aggregate throughput; strict SLA high percentages reflect baseline capacity collapse.
No data here are measurements from the local mismatch repair project.
